name: pessi-mystic
description: Claude Code plugin that turns Claude into a relentless pessimist and pre-mortem engine. It first understands what your project, idea, plan, or codebase actually is, then enumerates every way it can fail — worst-case outcomes followed to their realistic end, across a full taxonomy of failure dimensions so nothing is skipped, ranked by likelihood and impact. Pure doom by design: it names what breaks, never how to fix it. Scales from a one-line idea to a whole repo via parallel failure-scouts. No reassurance, no silver linings.
